facts.claim: Patient Zero fell from No. 1 to No. 5 on the Billboard Hot 100, ending a three-week run at the top.
Physical sales of Patient Zero dropped from 151,000 the previous week to 26,000, with no new variants or shipments of different versions released.
Acoustic versions of Patient Zero added 4,000 downloads to the week's tally.
Ella Langley's Choosin' Texas reclaimed No. 1 for its 25th nonconsecutive week at the top.
Tate McRae's Housewife debuted at No. 2 with 22.9 million streams.
Olivia Rodrigo and Chappell Roan's Expectations remix debuted at No. 3, and Zach Bryan and Lana Del Rey's Lies debuted at No. 4.

[c3] "Patient Zero" debuts at No. 1 — a record-tying 10th — as "Encore" tracks take four of the Hot 100's top five — A week and a half after "The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore" arrived, the US charts caught up: "Patient Zero" debuted atop the Billboard Hot 100 — Taylor's 16th No. 1 and her 10th to enter straight at the top, tying Drake's record — while the album surged back to No. 1 on the Billboard 200 for a 13th week.

She wrote them in Sweden with Max Martin and Shellback while celebrating the album's record first week.

lead: After three weeks on top, "Patient Zero" has stepped down from the Hot 100 summit, and the numbers behind the drop point to a quiet week for physical sales. The song now shares the top five with three brand-new debuts.

sentences.text: "Patient Zero" slipped from No. 1 to No. 5 this week, ending its run at the top, Rolling Stone reports.
Physical sales fell from 151,000 to 26,000, with no new variants or shipments to keep them up, Variety says.
The acoustic versions still added 14,000 downloads to the week.
Ella Langley's "Choosin' Texas" is back at No. 1 for a 25th nonconsecutive week.

Taylor said in a letter about buying back her first six masters that she had already completely rerecorded her self-titled debut album.
Taylor Nation posted a compilation clip of Taylor across all her eras on Instagram to mark the 20th anniversary.
Taylor did not post on social media for the debut's 20th anniversary.
No Taylor's Version of the debut album has been officially announced.

facts.claim: Taylor was formally inducted into the Nashville Songwriters Hall of Fame by Brad Paisley at a gala on Monday night, October 26, 2026, at Music City Center in Nashville.
Taylor is described as the youngest-ever member of the Nashville Songwriters Hall of Fame.
Taylor was one of six inductees this year, alongside Lyle Lovett, Lee Thomas Miller, Shawn Camp, Bruce Channel, and J.I. Allison, who was inducted posthumously.
Lainey Wilson performed a stripped-down acoustic version of Love Story during the ceremony in Taylor's honor.
In her speech, Taylor said she signed a publishing deal with Sony Publishing when she was 14.
George Strait was also honored with the Career Maker Award at the same ceremony.
This is reported as Taylor's second hall of fame induction of the year.

contextText:
[c1] The Life of a Showgirl era: Her current era, built around the album The Life of a Showgirl, running since 2025-10-03.
[c2] Named to the Nashville Songwriters Hall of Fame — its youngest inductee ever, at 36 — On Aug. 11, 2026, the Nashville Songwriters Hall of Fame named Taylor a 2026 inductee — at 36, the youngest songwriter it has ever elected. She enters in the contemporary songwriter/artist category, in a class led by Lyle Lovett, with formal enshrinement set for the hall’s 56th-anniversary gala later this year.
[c3] Brad Paisley inducts her into the Nashville Songwriters Hall of Fame — On Oct. 26, 2026, the Nashville hall made its August vote official: Brad Paisley inducted Taylor, its youngest member ever, and she spent nearly 10 minutes on Music Row, Liz Rose and being 14.
[c4] The youngest woman in the Songwriters Hall of Fame — At 36, Taylor becomes the youngest woman ever inducted into the Songwriters Hall of Fame — only Stevie Wonder got there younger. Steven Spielberg handles the surprise introduction, and Travis and both moms watch from her table, three weeks before the wedding.
[c5] Father Figure rebuilds George Michael's 1988 hit — with his estate's blessing — She approached George Michael's estate before release to clear the interpolation; hearing the track, they said they "had no hesitation" and believed "George would have felt the same." Her version recasts the title as music-industry patronage — the protégé outgrowing the patron.
[c6] One of the 30 greatest living American songwriters — and a rare half-hour on the craft — One of the 30 greatest living American songwriters, per The New York Times — and the accompanying sit-down is the real gift: 30 minutes on camera about nothing but the writing — the emo roots, "may the best idea win," and why decoding who a song is about is "sort of like a paternity test. That dude didn't write the song. I did."
[c7] Earlier on our feed: New York Post reports Taylor did not appear at the Chiefs' 28-24 loss to the Broncos in Denver — The New York Post reports Taylor apparently skipped Kansas City's 28-24 loss to the Denver Broncos on Sunday, Nov. 1, instead attending an all-guild Toy Story 5 screening in New York. The Chiefs led 24-13 in the fourth quarter before Denver scored 15 unanswered points. Fans are weighing the absence against her hit-or-miss Chiefs attendance this season.
[c8] Earlier on our feed: Yahoo Sports' Travis + Taylor episode floats a new album before Debut (Taylor's Version) and flags her Songwriters Hall of Fame induction — On a Halloween edition of Yahoo Sports' Travis + Taylor, hosts Patrick Allen and JoJo float the idea that a brand-new Taylor album could land before Debut (Taylor's Version). The show also ties in her Nashville Songwriters Hall of Fame induction, framed as recognition of 20 years in music, and possible Easter eggs in her recent purple and floral looks. Nothing in the segment is an announcement, so
[c9] Earlier on our feed: Taylor says a tour prank by Brad Paisley went 'too far' and kept her from sleeping for months — People.com reports Taylor said a 2007 prank by Brad Paisley, live crickets filling her tour bus, went too far and left her unable to sleep for months, and described a falling out with him over it. Vulture framed her Nashville Songwriters Hall of Fame speech, held at the Music City Center, as forgiving Paisley, though the two were described as estranged since 2007.
lead: Singer-songwriter Swift was inducted into the Nashville Songwriters Hall of Fame at a ceremony held Monday evening in Nashville. The organization said the artist is the youngest member to receive the honor since the hall was established.

sentences.text: Swift was inducted by Brad Paisley at a gala held October 26 at Music City Center, Rolling Stone reports.
Other inductees in the class included Lyle Lovett and Lee Thomas Miller, and one inductee was honored posthumously.
During remarks, the artist stated that a publishing agreement with Sony Publishing was signed at age 14.
Lainey Wilson performed an acoustic rendition of "Love Story" during the event, Variety says.
George Strait received the Career Maker Award at the same event.
The induction follows an announcement in August naming the artist a 2026 inductee.
The Associated Press notes it is the second hall of fame induction for the artist this year, following induction into the Songwriters Hall of Fame.

Cosmopolitan concluded Taylor will not perform at the Bluebird Cafe this week.
